props.name: value
props.description: Controlled layout: widget ids in reading order, with their spans.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the whole new layout after every move or resize.

props.name: widgetTitle
props.description: The widget’s name — its heading, and what move and resize announcements call it.

props.name: locked
props.description: Hide the move handles and size buttons — a read-only view of the same layout.
